body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 10). The Features tab prints a "Features" heading directly under the tab bar; the same pattern appears on the other tabs and pages, where the tab name already says what the panel is.

- Remove headings that repeat the tab name in `strategy` (`tasks_view`, `features_view`, `roadmap_view`, `vision_view` and their heading elements), in `settings`, and on the board where a heading repeats a section name.
- Keep headings that name content the tab does not (e.g. "Run" inside a task detail, "Proposal" in the plan panel).
- Where a heading carried layout (spacing, a rule), keep the spacing with the tab bar's own margins so removing it does not shift the page.

**Tests:** strategy, board and settings view tests that assert the heading text are updated to the tab-only layout.
title: ui: Remove redundant headings
